## Work object

Link the Issue or other persistent work object. Use closing syntax only when this PR fully satisfies it.

## Scope

Describe what changed and what was intentionally left out.

## Verification

List exact checks that were run and their results. Distinguish passed, failed, blocked, unavailable, not applicable, and not run.

- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Relative Markdown links/referenced files checked when documentation changed
- [ ] Edited JSON/YAML parsed when structured files changed
- [ ] Repository-specific tests/build checks run when applicable

## Documentation impact

List canonical docs/indexes updated, or explain why no documentation change is required.

## Security and privacy impact

State whether the change affects permissions, storage, networking, page-content handling, telemetry/analytics, remote code, account/session behavior, or sensitive data.

Do not include secrets, private prompts, user data, credentials, or sensitive vulnerability details.

## Delivery boundary

- [ ] This PR does not claim deployment, publication, release, or merge unless that effect is separately authorized and verified.
